thread.text:
I got a set of Sonos speakers a few months ago. I hate them. They're obnoxious, laggy, buggy, etc.

Most importantly: they sound HORRIBLE.

I plugged in a mic and said "fix the sound". Claude did it. Holy shit.

I fixed the software ahead of this by moving to a fork of Music Assistant I built for shared play at the office.

I already had a MiniDSP UMIK-1 for this exact use case (I am an audio engineer and minidsp fanboy)

Was able to recreate everything I needed from DIRAC in literally 10 minutes.

Wild world we live in. I paid hundreds of dollars a year for software that is WORSE than what i can build in a few minutes.
